record.cardDesc: Record your actions for Agent reference
record.sectionHint: Generates a recording instruction — send it to your Agent to start recording your actions; the Agent can then use the resulting trace bundle to automate similar tasks.
record.promptTemplate:
Use BrowserSkill's `bsk` CLI to record the browser actions I'm about to demonstrate.

Steps:
1. Run: {{command}}
2. Once you confirm it's started, I'll operate in the opened window myself.
3. After I click Finish, read the written `./trace` bundle (`trace.json` + `states/`) and summarize what I did.

longScreenshot.title: Full-page screenshot
longScreenshot.cardDesc: Capture a whole page, preview and save it
longScreenshot.description: Automatically scroll the current page and stitch the captures into one crisp PNG.
longScreenshot.hint: For ordinary webpages. Captures the entire page vertically at the current window width.
longScreenshot.cancelled: Capture cancelled. Your scroll position has been restored.
longScreenshot.runningHint: Keep this tab open without scrolling or switching tabs. You can close this popup. Press Esc to cancel.
longScreenshot.previewHint: Your original scroll position has been restored. Previews are stored temporarily on this device; download images you want to keep.
longScreenshot.missingDescription: This preview may have expired or been removed. Return to the webpage and capture it again from Quick actions.
longScreenshot.downloadError: Could not start the download. Please try again.

errors.unsupported: This page does not support full-page capture. Use an ordinary HTTP or HTTPS webpage.
errors.unavailable: Could not access the page. Refresh it and try again. Browser pages and extension stores are not supported.
errors.busy: Another task is using this page, or a capture is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.changed: The page changed during capture. Keep the tab, window size and page content stable, then try again.
errors.tooLarge: The page exceeds the image size limit. Reduce the browser page zoom and try again.
errors.timeout: Loading or capturing took too long. Capture stopped and the page was restored.
errors.captureFailed: Could not complete the screenshot. The page was restored. Please try again.
errors.saveFailed: Local storage is full or unavailable. Free up some space and try again.
errors.interrupted: Capture was interrupted. No complete image was created. Return to the original page and try again.
